title: NA60019: Ocean Engineering Materials
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Types of materials used in ocean engineering. Classification : steel, non
ferrous metals, composites.Ferrous alloys : properties, heat treatment, Carbon
and low alloy structural steels, welding and associated problems. Non-magnetic
steels, stainless steels, creep resistant steels, high strength and high
toughness steels. Applications.Non-ferrous alloys : properties, heat treatment,
Copper alloys, aluminium alloys and titanium alloys, Applications.Different
types of commonly used composites : Concrete, fiber reinforced plastics.
Structural materials for marine floating structures. Marine application of
composite materials, fabrication method. Material characteristics
resin,
fibers. Elastic properties of FRP laminates. Laminate strength, effects of
immersion and weathering. Test methods for evaluation of laminate properties.
Structural analysis and design
evaluation of design loads, composite beam and
plate theories. Finite element analysis. Stiffened FRP panels. Superstructures
in FRP. Use of composite materials in underwater vehicles.Selection of
materials : criteria for selection and properties required for specific marine
applications; case studies.Corrosion : principles, stress corrosion cracking,
corrosion fatigue, hydrogen embrittlement, methods of protection, coatings.
